messages:
jamie: Heads-up — starting onboarding for 34B-mqa-v2 (weights uploaded). s3 path: s3://redwood-models/34b/mqa-v2/v1/weights.tar.gz. Quick checks I want before we flip: RoPE scaling sanity, sliding-window KV config for long chats, and tokenizer odd split on CJK punctuation. cc @sasha @tanya

sasha: got it. can you confirm how weights are sharded? single tar (monolith) or per-shard files? affects our loader and mmap plan.

jamie: single tar with 8 shard files inside (shard-0..7). I put a manifest at s3://redwood-models/34b/mqa-v2/v1/manifest.json. loader should read the manifest and stream shards.

tanya: re tokenizer — saw weird tokenization for '。' and fullwidth commas in chinese samples. they split into separate tokens for punctuation, which is okay, but leads to off-by-one in prefix cache size estimates. sample: "今天，很好。" tokenizes as [今天, ，, 很好, 。] which breaks some alignment tests.

marco: that's likely from the sentencepiece model variant. prob easier to add a post-tokenize normalizer for CJK punctuation (map fullwidth comma -> ascii comma) as a short-term fix. long-term we may onboard a tokenizer config flag.

jamie: agree. for now let's add a tokenizer normalizer in runtime config. also need RoPE scale check — model claims rope_alpha=1.0 in config, but the training repo used rope_scale=1.012 for 32k context. Anyone recall if we auto-scale in serving?

lee: runtime currently applies RoPE scaling only for models with "rope_override" set. default is no scaling. we do have a LUT for scale per model in /etc/model-metadata/rope-scales.json but it's sparse.

sasha: can you paste the model config snippet so I can run a quick compatibility lint?

jamie: sure —

```json
{
  "model_name": "34B-mqa-v2",
  "context_length": 32768,
  "rope_alpha": 1.0,
  "rope_scale": 1.012,
  "kv_shards": 8,
  "prefill_chunk_size": 1024,
  "tokenizer": {
    "type": "sentencepiece",
    "vocab_size": 51200,
    "normalizer": "none"
  }
}
```

marco: lint notes: - context_length 32768 -> need to ensure sliding-window buffer allocation for MQA is enabled. - rope_scale != rope_alpha: runtime will error if we don't set rope_override: true in serving config. - kv_shards matches weights (8) good.

tanya: for sliding window we need prefill_chunk_size <= 1024 to avoid huge mem spikes on long prefill. config has 1024 which is ok. also set sliding_window.step = 512 to keep GK cache trim.

jamie: thanks. can someone add rope_override: true to the serving config and add tokenizer normalizer map for fullwidth punctuation? small patch should be fine.

sasha: I'm on it, will open a PR against infra-models with the two-line change. will also add a quick smoke test that runs a 2k-step prefill then a 8k sliding-window exchange.

ci-bot: CI queued for jamie/34b-mqa-serve-config #124 — run: unit + runtime-smoke (approx 12m).

sasha: also adding a quick unit that checks manifest vs loader: ensure file count == kv_shards and checksums match. avoids boot surprises.

marco: FYI: small perf note — enabling rope_override will make attention kernel select the scaled-rope path which is marginally slower (~3% p95) but correct for position interpolation. we should measure after enabling.

jamie: acceptable trade for correctness. please also add a fallback policy in rollout: if p95 latency > 1.2x baseline during canary, auto-degrade to 8k context variant (we have a 8k-compat model).

lee: I'll add the rollout policy to the canary job. which metric do you want as the baseline? current 32k MQA baseline or hosted default?

jamie: use our internal baseline for mqa-34b (value in console under model-metrics/34b-mqa/v1). I'll attach the baseline numbers in the PR.

sasha: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra-models/pulls/457 — includes rope_override, tokenizer normalizer, manifest checker, and canary rollout tag. running CI now.

ci-bot: CI passed: runtime-smoke (12m), unit (8m). All green.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for 34B-mqa-v2 -> staging (canary=10%). Watch: https://console.redwood/canaries/34b-mqa-v2/2026-03-17-1832

tanya: quick heads-up — I ran a sample chat with multi-turn CJK content and prefill->sliding worked, kv memory steady. token alignment still off by 1 on a few edge prompts but normalizer fixed most.

marco: measured p95 up ~4% during canary — within expected. I'll run a perf build to see kernel hotspots.

jamie: great. once canary hits 30% and metrics stable, we'll promote. thanks everyone for quick turn. :thumbsup:

lee: noted. leaving the thread open for any post-promote regressions.

jamie: closing after promote, will post promote timestamp here.
